citations.quote: The Allentown School District (ASD) invites proposals
provide enterprise Data Warehousing Services that support both instructional improvement and districtwide operational effectiveness
The selected vendor shall be responsible for providing the deliverables identified below.
procure comprehensive data warehousing services from a single vendor
pricing includes all labor, materials, travel, and overhead unless otherwise stated.
labor, materials, travel, and overhead unless otherwise stated.
comprehensive data warehousing services from a single vendor capable of supporting both instructional and operational data needs.
at least three (3) comparable engagements, preferably for public school districts or similar public entities.

_note: Hand-authored 2026-10-11 as a stand-in for the model-backed extractor: the producer is swappable, the citation contract is not. Every value carries the span that grounds it; quotes are sliced out of the span index programmatically rather than typed, because these documents contain non-breaking hyphens. Services engagement for a data warehouse, procured from a single vendor. Experience asks for 'at least three (3) comparable engagements, PREFERABLY for public school districts' -- 'preferably' makes it scored, not a gate, so eligibility_gate is false.
